about: Nick Thorn Surf School, also called Nick Thorn Surf Coaching, teaches surfing at Putsborough at the sheltered southern end of Woolacombe Sands in north Devon. It runs group and private coaching for individuals, schools and companies. It is also a lifeguard training centre.
offers: Group lessons (2 hours; half or full days)
Private coaching, one-to-one or up to 4 people
goodToKnow: If there's no surf or it's unsuitable, you get a lesson voucher or an alternative activity
A registration form is available to download
gaps: Price list on the site is labelled 2022, so may be out of date; no details of what's included or what to bring.
